title: 장학금규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:17115:20010129:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 17115, January 29, 2001>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <40> Omitted.

<41> The Scholarship Regulations shall be amended as follows:

In Article 3 (1) 1 and (3), Article 8, Article 9, and the main sentence of Article 15 (2), respectively, "Minister of Education" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development."

In Articles 6 and 19, respectively, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education" shall be replaced with "Ordinance of the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development."

<42> through <152> Omitted.
